_about: Parts catalogue for sim/aircraft.py (the build) and sim/harness.py (the design search). sim/aircraft.py lists the fields each group needs. Prices read from aliexpress.us on 2026-11-12 (USD, US storefront). 'price' is the regular price of the exact variant; 'ship' is the shipping shown on the page. 'welcome' is the one-time new-shopper price, not used in totals. conf: page = variant price read on the item page; listing = lowest price shown in search results, variant not checked; est = my estimate. Electrical specs marked spec_conf est are my estimates from typical data, not from the listing. v9 Under-$300 entries (22 Nov 2026) were read from the shop page named in each 'conf'/'url'; they are item prices, shipping is only counted where 'ship' is set. Batteries: 'imax' is the continuous rating with no temperature cut-off; 'imax_burst' (where given) is the maker's rating with an 80 C cut-off, used only as the ceiling a fresh pack may reach before the firmware current limit acts.
